Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __and wherein the tool further comprises an additional structural element positioned within the medial section that is not present in the Hallez reference__.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises __a metal honeycomb structure having a specific density or porosity different from that disclosed in Hallez__.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure __with internal cell dimensions or wall thicknesses not disclosed in the prior art__.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material __comprising a metal honeycomb bonded to at least one reinforcing layer not taught by Hallez__.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is continuous, __and wherein the weld ring comprises a material composition or thickness specification not disclosed in Hallez__.

Claim 286 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring __has a radial thickness or cross-sectional profile different from the Hallez reference__.

Claim 287 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring __is formed by a process or method not disclosed in Hallez__.

Claim 288 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments __are affixed to the weld ring by a method or mechanism providing enhanced retention not taught in the prior art__.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, further comprising an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft, __and wherein the inner ring comprises a material or structural configuration not disclosed in Hallez__.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening __having a specific diameter or surface treatment not taught by the prior art__.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous, __and wherein the weld ring comprises a segmented or modular structure with individual segments that are separately formed and then assembled together__.

Claim 294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring __comprises a plurality of discrete segments that are bonded or mechanically fastened together in a manner not disclosed in Hallez__.
